'''2010 US East Nationals Matt Jourdan DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Jourdan]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Big Weapon
* '''Username:''' Fishfleas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
